name: Framework Act on AI Development and Establishment of Trust (인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법, AI Basic Act)
summary: South Korea's AI framework law. The national law database (law.go.kr) lists original enactment as Law No. 20676 of 21 January 2025, effective 22 January 2026, with an amendment (Law No. 21311) dated 20 January 2026. MSIT announced a legislative notice for the draft Enforcement Decree in November 2025 covering high-impact AI criteria, transparency requirements and safety requirements for systems trained with at least 10^26 FLOPs, and stated a grace period of at least one year before administrative fines. Obligation details come from the MSIT notice of the draft decree, not from the statute text; the final decree text was not read. Law.go.kr page was machine-translated.
key_obligations: Transparency and safety/trust requirements for AI operators, including high-impact AI criteria (per MSIT draft decree notice)
Safety requirements for AI systems trained with at least 10^26 FLOPs (per MSIT draft decree notice)
Administrative fines subject to a grace period of at least one year (per MSIT)
Establishment of supporting bodies such as an AI Safety Institute and AI Policy Center (per MSIT notice)

timeline.note: Promulgated as Law No. 20676 (law.go.kr); effective one year after promulgation.

MSIT announced legislative notice of the draft Enforcement Decree; comment period stated to run to 22 December 2025. The key_obligations listed for the decree come from the draft decree as notified, not the final decree.
Amendment Law No. 21311 (adds learning data definition, renames the national committee, among others) per law.go.kr.
